## Current work — matched device firmware after replacement18 qualification

Replacement18 final VM/local-protocol qualification is complete and published at `8b5113fa164ada7d002ab138b1e3a9bf795e9de5`; both exact-head hosted checks passed. Distribution `7f58b7b1c592908dcd0ba5987955e59aaa79fe66`, ES `1d76b3da7da75794066df1c089931b890304da7a`, immutable bundle `f557176651026f59bb5931993b12491a6019c0383321fb89fa1a05a596514fe6` remain unchanged. [Qualification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/8b5113fa164ada7d002ab138b1e3a9bf795e9de5/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-pixelelated-replacement-18/qualification.md) explicitly combines 13 unaffected standard suites with the separately qualified #527 walk correction and the 78-frame comparison. The original qa-21 aggregate rc1 is preserved; it is not relabelled an all-green run. WebDAV, SFTP and S3 each pass 108 assertions (324 total). Clean installed CF10, public configuration preservation, #526's complete installed hook and the 31-check candidate16→18 update are accepted separately.

#527's published QA source `2e484871bd` and bounded frame claims `7233b237ee` pass at 640×480 and1280×800, with all16 new frames reviewed and exact config/path/local/cloud witnesses preserved. The corrected comparison has no unexplained or missing frames; the old wrong-screen control still fails. No baseline or blanket-mask change. Canonical menu/flow references and exact-source EN/FR branch evidence accompany the implementation. Prior source-overlay proofs remain labelled as such and their source inputs are mapped to the installed firmware.

#508 and #527 are complete; #507/#524/#526 remain complete and must not be rerun. All owned QA guests/providers and temporary payloads are stopped and retired after compact evidence retention. H70002 preparation is active from published `8b5113fa164ada7d002ab138b1e3a9bf795e9de5`, with zero product delta from qualified replacement18 and29 product paths changed from priorH700. Frozen manifest `2918052ed6aaa4709bdff0513bcfdd098327f44c8238a2c24ae5c8e16fe4ff26` binds source, container and24/4 concurrency. The new build worktree is `/workspace/repos/rocknix.worktrees/m7-pixelelated-h700-02`; owner `/workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-h700-refresh-02` currently copies and verifies independent ARM/aarch64 caches. Standard watcher run `20261008T203802Z-e3e87b34` has actual host launcher625682, runner625683, watcher625684 and command625713; active session supervision is in place. No compiler is submitted yet. Guarded swap reclamation passed with8GiB free; measured1.67TB available exceeded the500GiB copy/build budget. Checksum equality and cross-root inode separation must pass before compilation. Then canonical H700 ARM→aarch64, installed inclusion and independent DDR3/DDR4/update acceptance precede SM8550. No physical action or RC designation. Source/licence #344, branding #359, release/version/publication #265 and separately scoped physical gates remain. #519 precedes any owner handheld update transfer/reboot. No RC designation or personal-cloud/device mutation is implied.

## Maintainer request

> You have my approval to do the cleanup, and you have my approval to generate the H700 build. Following the H700 build, we should try the SM8550 build.


Can this be done on the VM? Common software behavior is qualified on replacement18. Compilation, host capacity, ARM handoff and raw/update artifact inspection are build-host facts. Named physical boot/panel/radio facts remain separately scoped and do not gate compilation. #519 remains mandatory before the owner's next handheld update transfer/reboot.

## Acceptance criteria — refreshed firmware

- [ ] Frozen manifests bind the qualified product-source comparison, distribution/ES pins, actually observed pinned container, shared source cache and24/4 concurrency for each target.
- [ ] H700 ARM compatibility output is rebuilt or reused only after exact affected-input/output comparison, with the installed handoff checked in the new aarch64 firmware.
- [ ] New H700 aarch64 build follows capacity/preflight and verified cache isolation; terminal channels/seals/owner exits and raw/update identity pass for hashed DDR3/DDR4 artifacts.
- [ ] New SM8550 build follows accepted H700 and its own measured capacity/preflight; verify terminal channels and hashed image/update artifacts.
- [ ] Artifact inspection binds lowercase identity, current qualified source pins and corresponding source/licence inventory. Physical/release gates remain explicitly separate.

Watcher recording plus active session supervision is required; #395 off-session alert delivery remains outstanding. The cache job above is active; the compiler is not yet submitted. D-INFRA-022 keeps only immediate-test payloads and compact durable records; #493/#494 own retention. Standing authorized cleanup is scoped by actual dependency checks, never inferred from stale historical unapproved proposals.
